profile.creatorstats.writingIntro: Private reflection on your lore across every table — not shared or ranked.
profile.creatorstats.headlineSelf: {{words}} words across {{pages}} lore pages you've shaped
profile.creatorstats.headlineOther: {{name}} has shaped {{words}} words across {{pages}} lore pages
profile.creatorstats.emptyEarly: Your portfolio is just beginning — every world starts somewhere.
profile.creatorstats.totalWordsCreatedDe: Words on lore pages you originally created, across all your tables.
profile.creatorstats.wordsAddedDescripti: New words you've added across all tables — including private work.
profile.creatorstats.wordsAddedMeasuredD: Word-level additions from saves and publication, not reconstructed net totals.
profile.creatorstats.wordsRemovedDescrip: Word-level removals from your saves. Not proof of original authorship.
profile.creatorstats.netChangeDescriptio: Added minus removed for your saves. A rewrite can net near zero.
profile.creatorstats.writingCadenceDescr: Average active days per week over the last month.
profile.creatorstats.substantialRevision: Pages where you reshaped a large share of the text.
profile.creatorstats.favoriteWritingHour: When you tend to write most, based on recent sessions.
profile.creatorstats.heatmapHelp: Each square is a day you returned to the work. Choose a day to see that day's sessions.
profile.creatorstats.heatmapHint: Choose a day to open its sessions and pages.
profile.creatorstats.sessionsEmpty: No inferred sessions that day — a save without a heartbeat still leaves a mark on the map.
profile.creatorstats.hourlyHelp: Session minutes in your reporting timezone, not the clock on the campaign's world.
profile.creatorstats.trendHelp: Measured change between saves. A rewrite can add and remove in the same day.
profile.creatorstats.chartsEmpty: No writing days in this window yet.
profile.creatorstats.exportHelp: Owner-only JSON or CSV of your contributions, daily totals, and sessions. Page titles and document bodies stay here.
profile.creatorstats.exportError: The export could not be downloaded.
